purpose: Close C-2 by fixing the durable logical Plan contract: one analysis mechanism, typed logical stage kinds with independent budgets and Coverage, and physical materialisation held private.
closes: C-2 seal blocker — 'consolidated logical-stage schema/conformance artifact absent'

decisionDependencies.claim: one mechanism, typed logical stages, physical materialisation private
rules declare requirements; the planner materialises the least sufficient view
physical storage schema is private and freely migratable
a query against a stored fact view never silently runs analysis or creates a Run
effectful work is unrepresentable as a Rule
C-2 status is CANDIDATE; this artifact is its binding form

principle.oneMechanism: There are not four analysis products. Rule evaluation, graph/reference queries, and reduction analysis are the same machinery over the same facts, differing in query and presentation.
principle.notOneStage: One mechanism is not one stage. Extraction, resolution, rule evaluation and policy have different budgets, different Coverage semantics, and different failure modes; a plan that cannot distinguish them cannot report honestly.
principle.publicVsPrivate: The logical stage kinds below are a PUBLIC durable contract. Physical operators are PRIVATE and may be inserted, reordered, fused, or elided by the planner without a contract change.

logicalStageKinds.coverageSemantics: inventory completeness; validation method and assurance level recorded
logicalStageKinds.whyDistinct: It is the integrity boundary. Everything downstream is defined relative to its identity.

logicalStageKinds.coverageSemantics: PER RELATION, not per stage — a plan may have complete syntax and unavailable resolved facts simultaneously
distinctFailureModes: truncated provider stream (operational — a truncated stream is a fault, not partial evidence)
logicalStageKinds.whyDistinct: Per-relation Coverage is what makes predicate-relative sufficiency (C-1) expressible at all.

distinctFailureModes: rule fault (isolated, does not fail the plan)
logicalStageKinds.whyDistinct: A rule exceeding its query budget must not be indistinguishable from a provider that could not resolve references.
Host-owned. Consumes findings and Coverage; contributes neither.
Effectful. Explicit grants, ephemeral workspace, never implicitly retried.

privateOperators.rule: These MUST NOT appear in the public Plan schema. Exposing them would freeze a storage strategy into a durable contract — the same mistake as exposing the physical fact schema.
privateOperators.plannerFreedom: The planner may insert, reorder, fuse, or elide any private operator provided the logical stage contract and the resulting EvidenceDigest are unchanged.

domainResults.rule: One analysis plane may expose several result contracts. They differ in shape, not in machinery.

queryNeverRunsAnalysis.assert: A query against a stored fact view MUST NOT silently execute analysis or create a Run.
queryNeverRunsAnalysis.whenFactsUnavailable: Return a typed unavailable response naming the missing requirement and what would satisfy it. Only explicit admission creates a Run.
queryNeverRunsAnalysis.why: Otherwise a read surface becomes an unbounded, unbudgeted, unrecorded compute surface — and agent loops make that the common path.

conformanceTests.assert: Every stage in a serialised Plan has a kind drawn from logicalStageKinds. An unknown kind is rejected, never ignored.
No serialised Plan contains any operator named in privateOperators. Round-tripping a Plan through the public schema loses no logical information.
Coverage is reported per fact RELATION, not per stage: a plan can report complete syntax and unavailable resolved facts in the same Run.
A rule whose declared requirements are unmet is recorded as skipped-requirements-unmet and never silently evaluated against insufficient facts (C-1 enforcement).
A budget exceeded in rule-evaluation and a provider unavailable in fact-derivation produce DISTINCT Coverage reason codes.
A query issued against a fact view lacking required relations returns a typed unavailable response and creates no Run.
Two Plans differing only in private operator selection produce identical EvidenceDigests.
A profile may raise a fact-quality floor but no profile label alone triggers materialisation absent a consumer requirement (C-1).

sealedPropertiesCovered.property: required partial coverage cannot yield pass
effectful work is unrepresentable as a Rule

peerReviewRequired: Confirm the five logical stage kinds are exhaustive — a sixth appearing later would be a public contract break.
Confirm per-relation (not per-stage) Coverage is the right granularity; it is the load-bearing choice here.
Confirm PS-07 is testable in practice — it requires the planner to expose alternative operator selections to a test.
knownLimitations: Stage kinds are named but their field-level schemas are not specified; that is the next artifact if this shape is accepted.
Budget units are named, not typed.
The probe stage is specified but implementation-gated, so PS-01's coverage of it is contractual only.
